hypothesis: Scaling a weekly cross-sectional crypto momentum book inversely with its own lagged realized volatility preserves the momentum premium while improving Sharpe and crash behavior.
universe: Point-in-time Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals. Each Monday keep the 30 contracts with highest trailing 30-day quote volume among assets with sufficient continuous feature history; delisted names remain eligible until their data end.
market_cap_deviation: The paper uses top-30 prior-December market capitalization. Historical market cap is unavailable locally, so lagged quote-volume top-30 is pre-registered as a tradability proxy.
momentum: At Monday 00:00 UTC, rank prior completed daily close divided by close 29 calendar days earlier minus one (paper's p[j-1]/p[j-30]-1 formation rule).
portfolio: Equal-weight long top momentum quintile / short bottom quintile, 0.5 gross each side.

risk_management.vol_estimator: sqrt(mean(raw weekly momentum return^2)) using only prior completed weeks
risk_management.scaling: target_weekly_volatility / lagged realized volatility; no lookahead

development_gate: canonical risk-managed net Sharpe >0.80, positive total return, and at least 2/3 volatility windows positive
success_gate: canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 2x costs, at least 2/3 vol windows positive, 2024 and 2025 each non-negative, max drawdown <35%
